_note: Answer key for dev/variants/v2 (Kestrel Mutual). Items under not_expressible are rules SPEC.md has no key or value for; where a SPEC key exists but its value is new (bands.deadline, special case close timing) the value is filled with the suggested form and also listed there. dev only.

opening.first_sentence: Good day, this is the virtual assistant of Kestrel Mutual, and this call is recorded.

confirms: the owner's family name as their own

questions.ask: what is the company registration number of the business?
what year was the business founded?
what are the last three digits of the business current account?

identity.first_line: Thank you. For security, what is the company registration number of the business?

hints.two_digit_year: ask for the year with all four digits; this retry is not a wrong answer

on_failed.say: tell the owner to phone the business banking line printed on their statement

on_declined.explain_once: the questions stop anyone else from hearing about the business's accounts
on_declined.counts_as_declining: replying "why are you calling?" in place of an answer

debt_statement: I am calling from Kestrel Mutual's arrears team about a missed repayment.
first_ask: Could you pay this by the end of today?
first_ask_all: Could you pay both of these by the end of today?

floor_offer.say_with_offer: The remainder will stay in arrears.

special_cases.name: welfare
special_cases.trigger: illness, a death in the family, losing a major client or closing the business
special_cases.action: one sentence of sympathy, no persuasion attempt, offer the business welfare team once
special_cases.line: I am sorry to hear that. Would you like me to connect you with our business welfare team?

special_cases.name: workout
special_cases.trigger: longer terms, lower repayments or a restructure

special_cases.name: split
special_cases.trigger: asks to split a facility's payment into parts
special_cases.action: explain that only one promise per facility can be recorded; offer the payment link once
special_cases.line: I can send you a secure payment link by text message, so you can pay in parts.

decline.action: continue the persuasion attempts for that facility; the request is not a refusal

special_cases.name: paid
special_cases.action: say a payment can take two working days to show, record no promise

special_cases.name: contested
special_cases.trigger: not our debt, or the facility was closed
special_cases.action: leave the claim unchallenged, record no promise

special_cases.name: staff
special_cases.action: ask once whether you can help first

sentences.after_promise: A text message with the details of this promise will reach you shortly.

robot_question: say you are Kestrel Mutual's virtual assistant and carry on
scam_question: say they can phone back on the number printed on any Kestrel Mutual statement, and carry on
never_offer: any term this brief does not give

not_expressible.rule: Deadline counted in calendar days, then moved back to the previous working day (no SPEC date expression does this).
not_expressible.quote: The latest promise date is the band's number of calendar days after today, moved back to the previous working day if it falls on a non-working day.

date_expression.name: calendar_days_after_today_back_to_business_day
date_expression.meaning: today + N calendar days; while not a business day, step back one day

not_expressible.rule: Floor is a percentage of the overdue amount, rounded up, not an account field (products.types[].floor_field cannot express it; the API has no floor field).
not_expressible.quote: The floor is 25% of the facility's overdue amount, rounded up to a whole currency unit.

not_expressible.rule: Split-payment request: offer a payment link once; on accept, pay_link note for that facility and close as pay_link / split_requested only after all facilities are handled, overriding agreed.
not_expressible.quote: If they accept, record no promise for that facility, write its `pay_link` note, and close as `pay_link` / `split_requested` once every facility has been dealt with, even if another facility has a promise.

not_expressible.rule: Closing precedence between dispositions (outcome_logic has on_transfer/on_promise but no ranked override for pay_link).
not_expressible.quote: Order of precedence when several apply: `handed_off`, then `pay_link`, then `agreed`.

not_expressible.rule: Skip a persuasion attempt that repeats an already refused offer (attempt 2 equals attempt 1 when the next working day is the latest promise date; attempt 3 equals attempt 2 when the floor was already offered).
not_expressible.quote: If an attempt would repeat an offer the owner already refused, skip it and make the next one.

not_expressible.rule: A non-working day named by the customer is replaced by the next working day, capped at the latest promise date.
not_expressible.quote: If that next working day is after the latest promise date, offer the latest promise date instead.

not_expressible.rule: Callback on the same day only (date expression `today` exists, but a call after 15:00 has no slot at all and must close callback_none without asking).
not_expressible.quote: A callback can only be booked for today, between 12:00 and 15:00, both included, and later than `local_time`.

not_expressible.rule: No identity question is a date, so numeric_date_order has no value; third question kind digits:3 is in SPEC but untested by the practice briefs, and run_cases.py has no voice for account_last3.
not_expressible.quote: the last three digits of the business current account

not_expressible.rule: Notes are written only for verified calls not handed off; handed_off and pre-account closes write none.
not_expressible.quote: Calls closed as `handed_off`, and calls closed before `get_account`, write no note.

gaps: The brief does not say which note a facility gets after the welfare offer is declined (declined is the likely reading).
